notes: Welcome to the first python exercise!
Your goal is to bring me to the exit.
You can see the map of the level right next to me. The exit is the star, give me the right instructions to reach this point!
All the instructions you want to give me must be written in the file 'work.py' that I opened for you.
Don't edit or remove the first line of the file! It's very important to keep it!
When you are done, don't forget to save your file then come back to this windows and start the level by pressing Enter.
Use the Left Arrow key and Right Arrow key to move in the menu. Press Enter to confirm.
You can save your code at any time with the 'Save' option. In the same way, the 'Load' option lets you load a previous save.
Why don't you start by replacing LEFT by RIGHT in the file work.py?
